verdict.rationale: Firstbase's mail/address plan lists unlimited incoming mail scans and unlimited digital storage, and files can be digitized in-app. That implies received documents stay stored in the account rather than appearing only at notification time. The evidence does not say registered-agent notices or service of process are archived the same way, and does not describe how stored items are retained or retrieved. Missing for 10: explicit archiving of registered-agent legal notices, documented retention period and retrieval/search of past documents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, received documents stay archived in the account so a notice can be retrieved months later, not just at notification time
